Raw bounded SiteId search: LDRSB reads BaseRec+4 as signed; comparison uses full unmasked R1. Negative keys can match bytes80..FF. Signed base count bounds the loop and a miss returns-1. Do not narrow this interface to the separate TypeByte contract.

Raw TypeByte search masks R1 with0xFF before comparing the signed BaseRec+4 field. Keys80..FF cannot match that signed field. The raw nonempty search has no loop bound; the port safe-bound adaptation is separate from the bounded full-i32 SiteId search at5A8D0.
